definitions.short: a thing written , the characters, or a document (letter, copy, edict, poem)
definitions.full: H4385. miktab מִכְתָּב noun masculine 2Chr 21:12 writing ; — absolute ׳מ Deut 10:4 + 5t.; construct מִכְתַּב Exod 32:16 2 t.; — 1 = handwriting הוּא אֱלֹהִים מִכְתַּב וְהַמִּכְתָּב Exod 32:16 . 2 = thing written, Exod 39:30 (accusative of congnate meaning with verb with כָּתַב ), Deut 10:4 ; specifically a royal enactment or edict (= כתם כְּתָב 4 ), 2Chr 35:4 || כְּתָב , 36:22 = Ezra 1:1 ; a prophetic writing 2Chr 21:12 . 3 in a title , ׳מ לְחִזְקִיָּהוּ Isa 38:9 Writing of Hezekiah.
